item.title: Missing Man, Hospital Crisis, Abaco Blackouts
item.ns0:title: Missing Man, Hospital Crisis, Abaco Blackouts
item.description: Tonight on Our News, a desperate search for a missing 27-year-old man ends in a heartbreaking discovery that has left a community in mourning. We investigate the deteriorating conditions at a major healthcare facility that have forced the cancellation of critical surgeries and examine a landmark initiative granting long-awaited land titles to dozens of residents. Our team also brings you the latest on the persistent power crisis affecting the Family Islands and marks a significant shift in national health protocols as a major provider lifts long-standing mandates. Stay tuned for these stories plus your complete weekend sports and weather outlook. ----- Copyright Disclaimer under section 107 of the Copyright Act of 1976, allowance is made for "fair use" for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, education and research.
